name: AI Editor Post Switcher
author: 4wpai

sections.description:
AI Editor Post Switcher enhances your editing workflow by adding convenient navigation buttons directly to the Gutenberg editor header. This allows you to quickly move between posts, pages, or any custom post type without returning to the admin list view.

Key Features

  • Previous/Next Navigation: Jump to adjacent posts with a single click
  • First/Last Navigation: Optional buttons to quickly access the first or last post in your sequence
  • Post Type Selection: Choose which post types should have navigation buttons
  • Clean Interface: Sleek, unobtrusive buttons that integrate seamlessly with the WordPress editor
  • Translation-Ready: Fully translatable into any language

Time-Saving Benefits

  • Streamlined Editing: Move between related content without interrupting your workflow
  • Batch Updates: Easily make sequential edits across multiple posts
  • Content Organization: Quickly navigate through your content hierarchy

Credits

  • Developed by https://4wp.ai
  • Thanks to all testers and contributors
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-editor-post-switcher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AI Editor Post Switcher to configure which post types should have navigation buttons.
  4. Optional: Enable first/last navigation buttons if desired.
sections.faq:
Which post types are supported?

Standard Posts and Pages are enabled by default. You can enable or disable navigation for any post type using the plugin settings.

Can I customize the appearance of the navigation buttons?

Yes! The plugin adds CSS classes that you can override in your theme or via custom CSS.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. It loads only in the admin editor screens.

Does this plugin work with the Classic Editor?

No. It’s specifically designed for Gutenberg (block editor).
